MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 6 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 11
   C. 6
   D. 5

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

3. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 1

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 8

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 10

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
